accountHistory: SELECT id, kind, date, description, amount, unit, quantity, unitPrice, contentUnit, contentQuantity, employee
SELECT 'purchase:' || id AS id, 'purchase' AS kind,
product_name AS description, -total AS amount, unit, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice,
content_unit AS contentUnit, quantity * quantity_per_piece AS contentQuantity,
strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', posted_at / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AS sortDate, NULL AS employee
WHERE account_id = @id AND status = 'posted' AND total > 0
FROM client_payments p JOIN clients c ON c.id=p.client WHERE p.account=@id
-amount, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, date || 'T' || substr(created_at, 12),NULL
SELECT 'transfer-in:' || t.id, 'transfer-in', t.date, a.name, t.amount,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,t.date || 'T' || substr(t.created_at,12),NULL
FROM transfers t JOIN accounts a ON a.id=t.source_account_id WHERE t.target_account_id=@id
a.name || CASE WHEN TRIM(t.note) = '' THEN '' ELSE ' · ' || t.note END,
-t.amount, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, t.date || 'T' || substr(t.created_at, 12),NULL
FROM transfers t JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.target_account_id
ORDER BY sortDate DESC, id DESC
